The only defect class found is loss of index sub-entry indentation, recorded below.

findings.why_it_matters: Every sub-entry indent on this page is dropped: the markdown emits all lines flush left, whereas the PDF indents sub-entries under their parent heading. The parent/child relation is the whole information content of an index entry - 'METHOD-ID paragraph 269' as a top-level entry means something different from 'METHOD-ID paragraph 269' as a sub-entry of 'Method-name'. Pages 1247, 1248, 1253, 1255 and 1256 of the same index DO carry the indents (as '    '), so the loss is an inconsistency within the transcription itself, not a deliberate style choice.
findings.suggested_repair: Re-emit page 1249 with the same '    ' one-level indent prefix used on pages 1247/1248/1253/1255/1256 for every line the PDF indents.
